name: Winion Virus
source:
Winion is a data-type creature that lives in a digital environment.
They can think themselves and can feel emotions such as happiness and depression like humans.

In modern society, Winion is recognized as an important creature and classified as a living thing.

The country strictly manages and protects Winion, and Little Winion grows safely in the [Winion Repository].

Adult Winion is assigned various roles and works.

Therefore, it is illegal for an individual to raise Winion.

Huh?... Do you want to raise Winion?

Ah. Then you've come to the right place.
You can also raise Little Winion here.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3334660/Winion_Virus/]Steam[/url]]
